planSteps.description: Wait up to 60 seconds for the element with data-testid 'result' to appear (counting runs in a browser worker)
Hover the first element with data-testid 'sankey-link' and read its aria-label, which has the form 'X to Y: N ballots'
A 'sankey-tooltip' appears whose text contains the same X, '→', Y and 'N ballots' as that aria-label
The tooltip also shows a percentage followed by 'of source'
